source: live idle Claude pane on macOS, tmux 3.7b capture-pane -p -e, read-only; only the prompt and hint rows are recorded
source_rule: Claude Code 2.1.263, 2.1.268 and 2.1.269 add one contextual notification with segments ["new task? ", "/clear", " to save ", "<tokens> tokens"] after CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES (default 75) idle minutes when the context holds at least CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_TOKEN_THRESHOLD (default 1e5) tokens. <tokens> is Intl en-US compact with one fraction digit at >= 1000, lowercased, with the first ".0" removed.
note: Geometry and both rows are recordings. Tests reconstruct the other rows with synthetic dividers/status and synthetic native identity; this is not a live send.
